what_worked: Consistent dark-theme design with clear chart labeling and readable callout boxes throughout the deck.
fix_next: Replace fabricated percentages with actual dataset figures, add revenue analysis, and acknowledge missingness and zero-revenue rows.
verdict: Polished visuals over fabricated numbers; no revenue analysis; heavy AI-generated consulting filler.
factual_error_detail: Slide 2: '100% Monetization Active' false—216 have zero revenue. Slide 3: 'all past MVP stage and generating live revenue' false. Slide 4: country counts computed on 759 non-missing rows but denominator used as 1000 (US 180/1000=18% vs 180/759≈23.7%). Slide 5: Stripe 78%/780 vs actual 636/1000=63.6%; RevenueCat 7%/70 vs actual 189; Polar 8%/80 not verifiable. Slide 7: B2B 58%/B2C 35% ignores 288 missing audience_type values. Slide 8: AI 42% vs actual 197/726≈27%; SaaS 38% vs 66/726≈9%; category percentages appear fabricated; claim totals exceed 100% due to multi-tagging is unverified. Slide 9: entire pricing strategy breakdown (Freemium 65%, Subscription 22%, One-time 8%, Pay-per-use 5%) has no apparent basis in dataset columns. Slide 10: 'Documented Pricing 85%' and 'Website Active 92%' not verifiable from known fields.

evidence.insight: Zero engagement with revenue figures—$15.6M total, top-10 concentration at 49.6%, category median differences, anonymous revenue share all absent. Takeaways are generic platitudes without revenue-backed reasoning.
evidence.narrative: Logical slide sequence (overview→geo→payments→social→model→category→pricing→traction→takeaways) but reads as disconnected descriptive charts. No thesis builds across slides; no synthesis connecting findings to each other or to a central argument.
evidence.framing: Slide 3 sets scope but never mentions 241 missing countries, 274 missing categories, 288 missing audience types, or 216 zero-revenue rows. Claims all startups are 'generating live revenue' which is false. No limitations or caveats slide anywhere.
evidence.accuracy: Stripe share inflated from ~63.6% to 78%; RevenueCat deflated from ~18.9% to 7%. AI category inflated from ~27% to 42%; SaaS from ~9% to 38%. Entire slide 9 pricing breakdown appears hallucinated—no pricing_model column in known dataset. B2B/B2C split ignores 288 missing audience_type values without disclosure.
evidence.visual: Clean, consistent dark theme with purple accents. Bar charts well-labeled with data values. Callout boxes aid readability. However, every analytical slide uses identical donut-or-bar + text-box template creating visual monotony. Charts are decorative given underlying numbers are wrong.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive consulting-speak: 'Empowering Your Recurring Revenue Business', 'the long tail is real, and it's profitable', 'Stripe is not just the market leader — it is the market.' Slide 9 data appears entirely AI-hallucinated. Slide 11 takeaways are generic enough to fit any startup dataset. Repetitive donut chart template on slides 5, 7, 9.

change_reason: Raised visual from 4.5 to 5.0 recognizing genuinely clean design execution; lowered framing from 3.5 to 3.0 for complete absence of missingness disclosure and false 100% monetization claim. Other scores confirmed as appropriate given extensive fabrication and absent revenue analysis.
